wholePhysicalScope: The masonry fort follows OpenStreetMap relation 1554213, outer way 109746492 and courtyard way 109746494. The four mapped corner projections remain visible above the curtain walls. The modeled ranges leave the mapped courtyard open.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the mapped stone perimeter, open courtyard, roof masses and all four bastions. Nearer levels refine arches, roof dormers and masonry trim.
limitations: Represents the surviving stone fort photographed in June 2003. The outer and inner map rings set layout and scale.
Roof divisions, the landward gate, masonry detailing and individual grades are interpreted where no cleared view provided measurements.
Only the fort’s architecture is included. The historic-site park, detached exhibits and interiors are outside the model.
Original elevation remains provider-relative. Foundation details and exact local grades are approximate.
